messages:
Eve: Need a quick microcopy pass for the 'Generate credits' empty state on the Console Billing page. Current: 'No credits available'. Feels cold and doesn't give next steps.
Jon: Agree. Users should know how to top up, expiration, and who to contact for invoices. Keep it short in the UI but include a secondary help link.
Priya: Thoughts on three-line pattern: 1) one-line descriptive header 2) short guidance 3) CTA + small helper link. Example: Header: 'No generation credits left' Body: 'Top up to continue generating tokens. Credits expire in 90 days.' CTA: 'Buy credits' Link: 'See billing options'.
Eve: I like explicitness but watch the 'expire in 90 days' claim; that varies by plan. Maybe state 'credit expiration depends on your plan' and link to docs.
LegalBot: Confirm: don't promise refunds or make guarantees. Phrase like 'Expiration depends on plan — see terms' is fine. Avoid 'non-refundable' unless finance approves.
Jon: For compact places (like inline on model page) use an even shorter microcopy: 'No credits — Buy credits' with a small info icon that opens the longer tooltip. Tooltip content should include expiration, who is billed (org vs user), and quick remediation steps.
Priya: Tooltip draft (short): 'Purchase generation credits to continue. Expiration and billing depend on your subscription. Contact billing or admins to manage org credits.' Is that too long for a tooltip? Keep under ~120 chars.
Eve: That draft is 119 chars — ok. Accessibility: tooltip must be keyboard-focusable and the CTA in it needs aria-label like 'Open billing page to buy credits'.
DesignBot: A11y checklist: tooltip appears on focus, role="tooltip", has visible dismiss, links have descriptive text, and contrast meets AA. For inline CTAs use `aria-describedby` to point to the tooltip if needed.
Jon: Button copy variants: Primary = 'Buy credits' Secondary (org-admin flow) = 'Request credits' (this triggers an internal request to finance). For org-level notice include small muted text: 'Applies to organization credits' when relevant.
Priya: Error empty state for failed purchase needs microcopy too: 'Purchase failed — payment declined. Update payment method or contact billing.' Include primary CTA 'Update payment method' and secondary 'Contact billing'. Use role="alert" for the inline banner.
Eve: One more: onboarding empty state when trial credits used up — softer copy: 'Trial credits finished. Ready to keep building? Buy credits or upgrade plan.' CTA: 'Upgrade plan' and 'Buy credits' (both present).
Jon: Let's capture variants in the spec: empty state (global billing page), inline compact state (model page), tooltip copy, failed purchase banner, and trial-finished copy. Keep language active and remediation-focused.
Eve: I'll update the design doc with exact strings and ARIA notes. After Legal/Finance thumbs we'll lock the copy. Thanks! :sparkles:
